American Diabetes Month®

Double Your Impact

This American Diabetes Month®, your gift will be DOUBLED up to the $150,000 campaign total! When you give, you stand with millions working toward a future free from diabetes.

Donate Now

Make a Monthly Impact

A monthly gift of $19 provides steady, reliable support that helps fuel diabetes research, trusted education, advocacy efforts, and community support.

Become a Monthly Donor Give Today

events

November is American Diabetes Month

If you want to make the most of American Diabetes Month, whether that’s understanding your risk or learning about ways to manage diabetes, we are here to help you on you your health journey. 

Learn More

What's Happening?

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy living resources, and more!

Image
meetings

Clinical Update Conference

Join us for three days of expert-led sessions focused on applying the latest Standards of Care in Diabetes and Standards of Care in Overweight and Obesity to everyday practice. 

Register Now
Image
advocacy

Advocate for Affordable Insulin Now

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

Contact Your Legislators
Image
SHOP DIABETES

Shop Now and Save 25%

Shop during American Diabetes Month. Your purchase makes a difference! Save 25% on your order when you use code ADM26 at checkout.

Shop Now
Image
Diabetes Prevention

Take Steps to Prevent Type 2 Diabetes

Understanding your risk and taking early action are key steps for diabetes prevention. Explore expert-backed tools and programs to help you lower your risk for type 2 diabetes. 

I Can Do It
Image
meetings

2027 Scientific Sessions

Save the date for the 2027 Scientific Sessions of the American Diabetes Association® (ADA) in Washington, D.C., June 18–21, 2027 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center.

Register Now
Image
camp

ADA Camp Registration is Open

Explore our camp experiences designed to build confidence, independence, and connection—while creating friendships and memories that last a lifetime. 

Learn More
Image
Take Action

Access to Obesity Treatment

More than 50 percent of new cases of diabetes every year are linked to obesity. 
 

Learn More

Diabetes By-the-Numbers

The numbers are staggering. Diabetes isn't just a disease—it's an epidemic, affecting over 40 million Americans with devastating consequences.

1.5M

Americans are diagnosed each year

12%

of Americans are living with diabetes

115M+

American adults are living with prediabetes

But there's hope. Join us as we continue the fight to end diabetes and work to find a cure.

Become a Diabetes Advocate Share Your Story

Meet Alex

Learn how Alexandra Park manages her type 1 diabetes while busy as an actress, writer, and producer! 

Read Her Story
